scope: One finite native-unit exploratory development run; cache labels already exposed; no untouched confirmation, no protected H5/test37 participation or transfer of these checkpoints into original H5 evaluation
authorization: Current delegated user explicitly authorizes bounded development baseline after scientific reassessment; previous no-training-turn flags remain historical, not overwritten
target: log10 of cached native positive point MIC lower_raw_unit; never interpret censors/ranges/plusminus as exact or convert unit
data: Exactly85 flagged point rows,46 mass and39 molar. Unknown covariates and all original metadata retained; no complete-case deletion
split: Leave one existing source-family union component out;10 mass folds and7 molar folds. Assert zero overlap of peptide ID/exact sequence/chemical fingerprint/family/source-group/known paper source keys. No row shuffling across folds; actual sizes recorded, refuse insufficient train groups
train_weights: Each training source-family group equal, each peptide within group equal, each observation within peptide equal:1/(G*P_g*n_i), sum1. All methods same train rows and weights

ridge.features: 20AA exact-sequence fractions in fixed alphabet order plus log(length); no imputed chemistry or potency features
ridge.standardization: Training-weighted mean/std only; zero std replaced1
ridge.objective: sum_i w_i(y_i-intercept-z_i beta)^2 + alpha*sum_j beta_j^2; intercept unpenalized

cnn.batch: All training rows, at most45 rows; full-batch repeated-observation weights exact
cnn.loss: weighted squared error on native log10 target, weights sum1
cnn.initialization: reset same seed1729 independently everyfold/unit; Glorot; dropout.5 as audited model
cnn.endpoint: Exactly100updates, no validation loss used during fit, no early stopping, no schedules, no hyperparameter/seed search
cnn.adaptation: Architecture-equivalent PyTorch, not author training-protocol or performance reproduction. Full batch weighted objective and100epochs are explicit development adaptations
cnn.training_label_centering: Subtract training fold group-peptide-weighted mean log10 target and add it back to predictions; validation labels never used for centering. Engineering preaudit recommendation fixed before execution.

evaluation.primary: macro-group MAE = average over heldout source groups of average over peptides of average over records absolute log10 error
evaluation.secondary: sqrt(macro-group MSE), with same nested weights; not average of fold RMSE
evaluation.metrics_scope: Eachunit independently; no pooling numerical units, no confidence/significance or independent-generalization claims
evaluation.predictions: Write all OOF prediction rows once after each heldout fold, before aggregate scoring; retain raw unit/value/operator, peptide/family/group/source and missingness

limits.model_execution: serial CPU only; no MPS/GPU; check active jobs before launch

failure_rules: Any source/code/config/hash or fold-overlap mismatch aborts before model fit
Any nonfinite loss/gradient/prediction or absent model parameter gradient aborts entire run
Any resource limit stop preserves failure and completed folds; no retry or reseeding
Incomplete OOF rows produce only partial status, never aggregate success
simple_signal_rule: Describe point estimates versus constant only; no minimum advantage or statistically significant claim, report allmodel outcomes including negatives
prohibited: test37 or original train/dev file access
